Definition: of Latin origin; a mna (i.e. mina), a certain weight:-- pound.
BiblicalUsage: A mna is a mina, a weight of silver and a sum of money — the nobleman in Jesus' parable gives one to each of ten servants with the order to trade until he returns. One turns it into ten, one into five, and one hides his in a cloth and hands it back untouched.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the mina is a test of faithfulness, not of talent: what matters is whether I put what He gave me to work.
